title: finding(ci): `board-snapshot.yml`'s adopt section says a patrol-adopting repo 「has the middle two」 — true of the FILES, false of the EXPORTS, and the sentence beside its own ⛔ warning is the one adopters act on
body:
## Summary

The 「Adopting this in a sibling repo」 section of `.github/workflows/board-snapshot.yml` tells an adopter that a repository which already has the half-state patrol 「**has the middle two**」 files. That is true of the **files** and false of what the archiver actually needs — and the section's own next sentence says why:

> Copy FOUR files, unchanged: … `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` (the archiver imports its proxy-re-exec plan and its repo resolver) … A repo that has already adopted the half-state patrol **has the middle two**.
> ⛔ Do not shorten this list from memory — **the imports decide it, not this comment**, and the patrol's own adopt list was wrong for months in exactly that way, which installed a dead sweeper that failed before its first predicate.

⇒ the warning is **correct** and the sentence beside it is what a reader acts on. An adopter who has the file but not its exports writes a workflow the runtime refuses at module load.

## Measured — objectui, today

objectui has both middle files and **neither of the two exports** the archiver needs. Its copy is a pinned port that predates the proxy plan:

| symbol imported by `board-snapshot.mjs` | objectui | objectstack `origin/main` |
|:--|:--:|:--:|
| `EXIT_PREREQUISITE_NOT_MET` · `labelNames` · `resolveSweepRepo` | ✓ | ✓ |
| **`PROXY_FLAG`** · **`proxyRearmPlan`** | **absent** | ✓ |

CI reproduced it in 10 seconds, at module load, on objectui PR objectui#10203:

```
SyntaxError: The requested module './check-half-states.mjs'
  does not provide an export named 'PROXY_FLAG'
```

⭐ And the precedent the warning cites came true **on the same pair of files, one repository over**: objectui#9387's premise section shortened the list from four to two on 「the file is present」, which is the failure mode the warning names verbatim.

## ⛔ What this card does NOT claim

- ⛔ Not that the warning is missing. It is there, it is right, and it is the reason this was diagnosable in minutes. The defect is that a **falsifiable convenience sentence** sits beside it and is the one a reader acts on.
- ⛔ Not that objectui's port is wrong. It is pinned at `bf10debd5`, which **predates** the proxy plan — a legitimate older port, not drift.
- ⛔ NOT measured: whether any other sibling repository has the same gap. Only objectui was adopted.

## Suggested shape

Name the **five imported symbols** in the adopt section instead of the file count — or better, make the archiver's own `--self-test` **assert its imports resolve**, so the adopt list is checked by the thing that travels with the file rather than by a comment. ⭐ The second is the shape the warning itself argues for: 「the imports decide it, not this comment」.

Dedupe words: `board-snapshot` · `adopt list` · `check-half-states` · `exports` · `PROXY_FLAG` · `has the middle two`
